newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London tread water.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London tread water.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London started off the fourth quarter on a quiet note, with profit-taking and the lower close in Tokyo dampening interest, traders said.

"We've seen some profits booked but not too much pressure. The market lacks momentum in either direction," one dealer said. In London, the Nikkei 50 index was up 0.53 point at 1,466.72 points after the benchmark Nikkei 225 index shed 93.43 points in Tokyo to close at 21,462.97.
"Sentiment is reasonably confident, helped by the dollar. But there seems some resistance around 111.75 yen so there are few impulses there to work on," a second dealer said.
Dealers were loathe to single out stocks in a generally torpid market. Hi-technology shares, which drove the market last week, were mixed to slightly weaker. Other stocks were steady.
Traders said a quiet week was expected as the market held on to wait for Friday's U.S. payrolls data for clues to future U.S. rate policy and the dollar's movements.
